options: Differ for desktop, web and app use
Do not exist, fonts are unprotected

options: Legally unsettled and different by country; human authorship is generally required

options: Evidence of ownership, such as original files and dates

options: An ethical issue of passing off others' work as your own

questions.q: Why is prevention important in digital copyright?
options: Because digital works have no copyright
Copies spread fast, cross borders and are hard to trace

questions.q: A hash function turns a file into…
options: A fixed-length string that acts like a fingerprint
A smaller version of the same image
An encrypted file you can reopen with a key

questions.q: Which property describes hashing?
options: One-way: you cannot rebuild the file from the hash
Two-way: the file can be restored from the hash

questions.q: If you change one pixel of an image, its SHA-256 hash…

options: The hash shows who the author is
Store the hash with a date; a matching hash later shows the file existed unchanged
The hash can be decrypted into the design
The hash stops others from copying

options: It cannot be computed for images
Resizing or re-saving an image changes the hash, so edited copies are missed

options: Encryption is one-way; hashing is reversible
Hashing is one-way with no key; encryption is reversible with a key

questions.q: Encryption turns a readable file into…
options: Ciphertext that can be reversed with the right key

questions.q: Symmetric encryption uses…
options: One shared secret key to encrypt and decrypt
A different key for each pixel
A public and a private key

questions.q: Which is an example of symmetric encryption?

options: A public key and a private key pair

options: Asymmetric encryption is faster for large files
Fast AES encrypts the file, and asymmetric encryption protects the AES key

options: Once the content is decrypted on screen or speakers, it can be recorded

questions.q: DRM is best described as…
options: Encryption plus licence rules controlling who can use content and how

options: The user, by typing the file name
A licence server that checks the user's rights

questions.q: Which is a drawback of DRM?
options: It removes the need for a licence
It can inconvenience honest users and lock content to a platform
It is not based on encryption

options: Writing the author's name in the metadata
Encrypting the whole file with a shared password
Encrypting the file's hash with the signer's private key

questions.q: A digital signature proves…
options: That nobody can copy the file
Who signed the file and that it has not changed since
That the file is free to use
That the file is in the public domain

questions.q: To verify a digital signature, the receiver uses…

options: A signature also proves who made the file
A hash proves who made the file
A hash needs a private key

options: It cannot store the author's name
It is easy to strip, for example when uploading to social media
It is not allowed by law

questions.q: A visible watermark mainly aims to…
options: Deter theft and credit the owner

questions.q: An invisible watermark is designed to…
options: Stay hidden but survive compression and cropping

questions.q: Embedding a watermark in frequency data (e.g. DCT) is usually…
options: Less robust than changing the least significant bit
More robust against compression and resizing than changing pixel bits

options: A leak can be traced to the person who received that copy

options: A way to compute a hash
Scrambling data so it is unreadable but visible
Hiding data inside another file so nobody knows it is there

options: The existence of the data, not just its meaning

options: Its own features, such as audio or visual patterns, compared with a database
A visible logo placed on it

questions.q: Why does fingerprinting find edited copies that a hash cannot?
options: It matches features that survive cropping and re-encoding

questions.q: On a Content ID match, the owner can…
options: Block, monetise or just track the upload

options: A signed record of who made it, with which tools, and what edits were made
A copy of the original on a server only

questions.q: Why is C2PA especially relevant now?
options: It encrypts all social media posts
It helps show whether content is original, edited or AI-generated
It makes AI images public domain
It removes the need for licences
